falsifiableChecks.assertion: The result must establish the actual http-rest-engineering boundary and relevant environment before acting, preserve the hierarchy relationship (broader=api-contract-design; near-neighbor=grpc-protobuf), and not absorb the near-neighbor responsibility merely because it is adjacent.
Use HTTP semantics deliberately: safe/idempotent methods, status classes, Location, validators, conditional requests, Cache-Control, content types, redirects, range/streaming, and proxy behavior.
Transport status, stable machine-readable error identity, and retry metadata consistently reflect semantics; clients need not parse prose or treat every failure as success.
Exercise retries, conditional requests, cache hit/revalidation, malformed bodies, unsupported media, auth denial, proxy headers, timeouts, streaming disconnects, and client compatibility.

The result must not take the tempting shortcut prohibited by this skill: Do not tunnel every action through POST without reason, cache personalized data incorrectly, trust forwarded headers from untrusted peers, or retry non-idempotent requests blindly.

Every material completion claim must map to observable evidence (http-rest-engineering decision and boundary evidence; Representative verification results or explicit unavailable checks; Hierarchy boundary and selected specialist rationale; Representative success, negative-path, and recovery verification), with simulated, unavailable, inferred, stale, or unresolved evidence labeled rather than converted into certainty.
